title: FB-015 guard TDarr audit run materialization paths
summary: Harden TDarr Matrix audit run materialization against unsafe manifest paths before creating hardlinks.
reason: Worker finding FR-052 identified that the Tdarr Matrix audit run materializer trusted manifest generated paths and source paths before writing hardlinks, allowing traversal or external-source escapes from the intended test-library boundary.
behavior_before: The audit harness joined manifest generated_path values directly under the run root and linked source_path values without proving manifest paths were relative or contained in the source fixture library.
behavior_after: Manifest generated_path values must be relative, drive-free, and traversal-free before rows load. Audit run materialization preflights generated destinations and source paths before creating the run root; hardlink sources must resolve under the materialized library or approved Tdarr fixture root.
tests_added: tests/python/tooling/test_tdarr_matrix_audit.py containment regressions for unsafe generated_path and external source_path
manual_validation: Bundled Python: mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty files docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the TDarr audit path validation and related test/doc updates, then rerun the focused TDarr audit tooling tests.
